description: Self-service dashboards and questions over the operator's own databases, so a report is a saved query rather than a spreadsheet mailed around.
authMethod: Proxy gate only - SSO is a paid tier; the free edition keeps its own login
packagingSource: vendored definition (platform/upstream/D11-01) pinning the published all-in-one image @ v0.65.2 with a pinned PostgreSQL sidecar

integration.authMethod: API key per user (session token in the free edition)

operationInventory.label: Read dashboards
operationInventory.description: List dashboards and their cards with the collection they belong to.

operationInventory.label: Read questions
operationInventory.description: List saved questions and fetch a question with its query definition.

operationInventory.label: Create a question
operationInventory.description: Create a saved question against an existing database connection.

eventModes.label: No event surface; dashboards and alerts are pulled

notes: The sidecar PostgreSQL is required: Metabase's embedded H2 store corrupts under concurrent use and loses saved questions. MB_ENCRYPTION_SECRET_KEY and MB_SESSION_SECRET_KEY must be supplied, otherwise data-source credentials are stored unencrypted and session tokens are forgeable.
